display_name: Four printed defects in the Companies Law, 5759-1999, and its regulations, recorded as typed values with their tests: the commencement day of the Companies (Fees) Regulations, 5761-2001 (a Hebrew date and a Gregorian date 29 days apart), the last day of a temporary provision of the Companies (Motion for Compromise or Arrangement) Regulations, 5762-2002 (366 days apart), the saving clause in s 367(א)(1) of the Law, which keeps Ordinance sections that the Insolvency and Economic Rehabilitation Law, 5778-2018, cancelled, and five signature lines of Kovetz HaTakanot 7639 that print 25 Adar I 5776 beside 8 March 2016 (3 days apart); with six controls; not an encoding of the Law
domain_expert_review: none: no domain expert has read this against the source
seat: none: the row records printed facts and asks no question from a seat

source.note: the four texts above are unofficial consolidations, deposited as excerpts; a reading is CONSOLIDATION-ONLY unless NOTES.md says it was read from a page image of the instrument. The official pages read are in official/ and amending-laws/ with their page images. The fourth defect's source is the official issue only (Kovetz HaTakanot 7639); no consolidation is used for it. Every official instrument is deposited as an extract of just the pages cited: KT 6074 printed pp. 231 and 232, KT 6178 printed pp. 883 and 904, KT 7639 printed pp. 946 to 949, SH 2708 printed pp. 393 and 394; printed pp. 405 and 406 of SH 2708 were read but are not deposited because they carry text outside the row's scope.

expected_red.note: two assertions for each of four defects, each stating what the citing words need. Regulation 8 of the Fees Regulations prints a Hebrew date and a Gregorian date 29 days apart; regulation 66 of the Compromise Regulations prints a pair 366 days apart; s 367(א)(1) of the Companies Law keeps Ordinance section numbers that section 359 items (4) and (5) of Sefer HaChukim 2708 cancel (7 numbers on the page images alone, 137 more as the Ordinance consolidation places the cancelled chapters, which is CONSOLIDATION-ONLY); the fourth defect is five signature lines of Kovetz HaTakanot 7639 that print 25 Adar I 5776 beside 8 March 2016, which the routine places 3 days apart (the first line was read from the page image, the other four in the text layer only)

run.method: one Sonnet builder, from a written brief; the page images of the cited pages of KT 6074, KT 6178, SH 2708 (printed pp. 393 and 394, deposited, and 405 and 406, read but not deposited) and of p. 946 of KT 7639 were read by the builder; the other cited pages of KT 7639 were read in the text layer only
